subject: fix(50117): Using @extends in JavaScript + JSDoc removes method documentations (#50256)

triage.label: bug
triage.reason: Fixes JSDoc (method documentation) being lost for members inherited via @extends in JS class expressions. The change adjusts isExpressionNode and the class-heritage lookup so JSDoc augments tags resolve to the class, which affects quick info results.
